credits.title: Darah Pemuja Setan
credits.overview: It tells the story of the activities of a deviant cult that worships the devil in the Gunungkidul area and how this cult has claimed human lives in the surrounding community. Some people have begun to take action to find a way to stop it.

credits.title: Ayah, Aku Mau Cerita....
credits.overview: When his family stares down the barrel of criminal charges, a commoner channels his street smarts and knowledge of action films to tie the long arm of the law into an investigative Gordian knot.

credits.title: Ayah, Ini Arahnya Ke Mana, Ya?
credits.overview: Raised in the shadow of an emotionally distant father, a young woman must step up during a family crisis and navigate the burdens of adulthood without the guidance she always craved.

credits.title: Sebelum Senja Berakhir
credits.overview: The demonstration against the eviction of the Harmonie Damai nursing home reunites Sendja and Sundari, two old friends who are now separated by betrayal and are struggling and tracing old memories.

credits.title: Child of Kuntilanak
credits.overview: Sara Fitria, haunted by nightmares of a Kuntilanak, travels to the cursed village of Wonoenggal to uncover her past. There, with her friend Azizah and young doctor Majid, she confronts supernatural terror and dark secrets to free the village from its curse.
